intro: Costa Rica is Central America's oldest democracy.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years and cannot serve two terms in a row. The Legislative Assembly has 57 members. A new president, elected in February 2026, took office in May.

chapters.title: Green policies
text: Costa Rica pays landowners to protect forests and gets almost all its electricity from renewable sources.
